relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: a few studies have shown that TLR2 can bind to high-mobility group box 1 (HMGB1)

relationships.subject: TLR2
relationships.evidence_quote: This then leads to upregulation of NF-κB and increased transcription of genes encoding the IL-1 family cytokines and TNF

relationships.subject: TLR3
relationships.evidence_quote: TLR3 specific agonist (poly I: C) can increase TRPV1 expression and the functional activity of these sensory neurons

relationships.subject: TLR3
relationships.evidence_quote: activation of TLR3 in spinal cord microglia results in the activation of the nuclear factor κB (NF-κB), extracellular signal-regulated kinase (ERK), and p38 signaling pathways

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: Its recruitment can lead to activation of NF-κB, MAPKs, activator protein-1 (AP-1), and IFN regulatory factor 5 (IRF5)

relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: multiple cortical spreading depression (CSD) episodes induced significant HMGB1 release, and the HMGB1-TLR2/4 axis activated microglia

key_findings: Review: TLR2, TLR3 and TLR4 signal via NF-κB to drive neuropathic pain and are linked to migraine.
HMGB1-TLR2/4 axis activates microglia after cortical spreading depression.
